Figures 10–14 report per-scenario Quality–Cost scatter plots for all systems, providing a 2D trade-off view (R3.M1) rather than averaged improvements. Each marker is one (system, query) outcome; up-and-left is better. CADENZA often lies on the upper-left frontier, while the plots also expose per-query exceptions where a baseline’s narrow operator support happens to match the query.
